$comment: Recommendations (lib/recommendations.js): suggestions learned from what shoppers view and buy together. Products viewed in the same visit and bought in the same order (or by the same customer within basketDays) become pairs whose weight fades with halfLifeDays, so this season counts more than last; a pair is scored against how popular each product is on its own, so a best-seller does not crowd out everything else. Pairs hold no person: a shopper's own history is read only to choose their picks. A product page shows what is bought together, what else was viewed and what is like it; the home page shows picks for the shopper with the reason for each, what they viewed recently and what is popular now; the cart shows what goes with it. A signed-in shopper's past orders shape their picks only with a live grant for the purpose below (or when the store sets basis to optout); the products viewed in this visit always do, as they are what the shopper is looking at. Shown, clicked and bought (an order within attributionDays of the click) are counted per shelf. A store sets its own values in settings recommendations.<key>.
